title: It's the last day to apply to Startup School New York
text:
It's the last day to apply to Startup School New York Submitted by katm 4 points, 4 comments. Today is the last day to apply for Startup School New York on June 18. Don't miss the deadline!

Speakers include:

Chase Adam - Watsi

Shana Fisher - High Line Venture Partners and Andreessen Horowitz

David Lee - SV Angel

Apoorva Mehta - Instacart

Kathryn Minshew - The Muse

Zach Sims - Codecademy

Fred Wilson - Union Square Ventures

and more...
